about: After a treatment interruption, the latest leflunomide supply was on 2026-10-30 and the checked pathology reports put the last completed full blood count 94 days earlier.
Possible finding: the record holds no line confirming whether a full blood count was completed on the latest leflunomide supply date or in the preceding 84 days.
A completed full blood count 70 days before the latest leflunomide supply falls inside the published 12-week window.
